findings.message: defaultResolveParentIssueRef's issueForWorkflowId lookup is not exercised end-to-end (no on-disk DEF/LLD artifact fixture). The load-bearing candidate derivation IS covered by the new parentRefIdentifiers unit test, and issueForWorkflowId/resolveWorkflowRef have their own resolve.ts tests, so the gap is narrow — the wiring between the two is untested. An integration test over a temp artifacts dir would close it.

S005 ships as an exported seam (createBugfixTrackerIssue/closeBugfixTrackerIssue/completeBugfixTracker + the advance tracker opt) with no production caller yet — nothing in daemon/ or mcp/ mounts it on the approve/completion path. This is the known, intentional framework gap that has applied since S004 (the build-step resolver can't target epic-story tasks without a GH tracker), not a defect introduced here; a follow-up must wire the seam onto the daemon completion gate. Flagged so the seam isn't mistaken for live behaviour.
